Full character turnaround sheet on a plain neutral seamless mid-grey backdrop, three full-body views of the same person standing side by side in a row: front view on the left, left profile view in the centre, back view on the right. Identical pose in all three views — arms relaxed at the sides, feet shoulder-width apart, head level, neutral expression, mouth closed. Consistent scale across views, eye-level camera, identical even lighting on all three. Full body head-to-toe visible in every view, generous margin around the figure.
a sixteen-year-old East Asian boy, adolescent with smooth unlined cheeks, slender but sinewy build hardened by three years of hauling ore, gaunt hollow-cheeked face, skin tanned a dusty yellow-grey with dark grit settled in the creases, dark brown eyes, the left iris carrying a thin frost-like ring of pale silver, black hair slightly long and unbound with loose strands falling across the right brow.
The back view shows a rope burn scar across the right shoulder, healed and cracked open again at the edges, and a back laced with old scar tissue overlaid by a set of newer straight linear scars.
He wears a faded coarse hemp short jacket washed pale and split at the elbows, a plain hemp rope knotted at the waist, a ragged uneven hem, and is barefoot with mud-dark soles.
At his waist hangs a short knife a foot and three inches long, its blade carrying three deep nicks, its grip wrapped in old cloth worn concave into the exact shape of a hand; a small heavy black iron token, palm-sized, hangs at his chest on a cord, its faces carved with short worn characters smoothed by years of handling.
